answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with witness-kernel circles: admitting an identity needs a kernel of five unrelated agents who each vouch only once per season, then all five join the newcomer in one unpredictable live video call — a raven circle — so one operator cannot staff two circles at once; vouches are engraved on a ferrous-bound registry and burn the vouchers' stake if the newcomer proves fake; the outside-money fee doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs five fresh vouchers, another live group appearance, and twice the prior fee.
